items.item_text: Serve as a primary administrative resource for day-to-day operations and provide administrative support to the UC ANR Innovate team.

Process purchasing requests and requisitions, travel arrangements, reimbursements, expense reports, vendor payments, and other routine administrative transactions in accordance with UC ANR procedures.
Maintain accurate, organized, and secure office and program records, including confidential HR and fiscal documentation, and follow established retention and access requirements.
Coordinate recruitment and onboarding logistics, including interview scheduling, workspace and equipment set-up, system access requests, forms, and separation checklists; maintain related records.
Respond to routine administrative questions, research established procedures, and route complex or policy-sensitive issues to the appropriate resource.
Coordinate purchasing of project supplies and equipment, maintain office supply inventory, and identify cost-effective sources in accordance with procurement procedures.
Prepare and route administrative materials for contracts and service agreements; track status, required documentation, deadlines, and deliverables.
Coordinate logistics for UC ANR Innovate events, including room reservations, catering, participant communications, materials, supplies, and on-site staffing as needed.
Maintain spreadsheets and financial trackers for program expenditures, commitments, invoices, and balances.
